standardHnsw.selectionRule: highest validation recall; ties choose lower efSearch then lower M; test recall is not used for selection

selection.tieBreak: fewer validation mean rows, then smaller degree/beam/hops
selection.fixedRule: highest validation recall with theoretical fixed score cap <= 2048
selection.meanRule: highest validation recall with validation mean unique rows <= 2000

verdict.criterion: held-out top-1 recall >= 0.99 under fixed cap <= 2048 or mean unique rows <= 2000
verdict.reason: Neither validation-selected budget point reaches at least 99% held-out top-1 recall under the fixed 2,048-score or 2,000 mean unique-row screen.
